autoHint: The list is generated at display time: a published record shows up on its own, an archived or draft one disappears. No need to come back here.
autoEmpty: No published record in this module.
previewEmpty: Nothing to show: the link will have no submenu.
hiddenNotice: {count} record(s) hidden because archived or draft.
iconMissingNotice: {count} item(s) without an icon: only the title will show for those.
groupsHint: One entry per category, linking to the filtered list. No tick = all of them.
groupsEmpty: No category found in this module’s published content.
groupsNoVisual: A category has neither icon nor image.
